# Sanwariaji Temple

|website=https://shrisanwariyaseth.org/|image=File:Sanwaliaji3.JPG|creator=Shaktawat Ruler of Bhinder(Udaipur)}}
Sanwaliaji Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Krishna on the Chittorgarh–Udaipur Highway, Rajasthan, India.
